name: server-client-python-bounded-rest-exchange-9133
instr:
Give Tableau Server Client callers one coherent, opt-in budget for the resources consumed by a REST exchange, configurable as a Server default and overridable for an individual query. Budgets cover encoded requests, response bodies, XML structure, and collection traversal without imposing ceilings when omitted.

Server defaults and per-query overrides resolve into an immutable policy, with omitted override values inherited and consumption isolated between requests, copied options, and independent traversals. Both modern parameter encoding and legacy URL rendering reject an oversized final encoded request before HTTP execution. One logical response-byte allowance covers every redirect body and the final body; declared or actual overflow takes precedence over status classification, namespace detection, and model exposure, while exact-boundary responses proceed normally. XML depth, element, and applicable item limits are validated atomically before namespace state changes or group, user, project, or pagination collections become visible. `ExchangeLimitError`, imported with `ExchangeLimits` and `ExchangeStage` from `tableauserverclient`, reports the stage, limit name, configured limit, and observed value for every limit failure. QuerySet and Pager give page and item limits identical cumulative meanings, using validated pagination while preserving QuerySet access and caching semantics and Pager copying, starting-page, and unknown-total termination semantics.
